summary: @dogtrax #smallpoems They drew within two meteors escaping the well reborn in clouds to have passion drive apart The frost on the window the dew in the grass time marches as space collapses life folded like a Liu Cixin novel new engines always
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dogtrax #smallpoems
They drew
within
two meteors
escaping the well
reborn in clouds
to have passion
drive apart

The frost on the window
the dew in the grass
time marches
as space collapses
life folded
like a Liu Cixin novel
new engines
always
